content.text: Benign subcutaneous tumors composed of mature adipocytes enclosed by a thin fibrous capsule
ranging in size from 1 to >10cm that are
MC on the trunk, neck, forearm, & proximal extremities
– may be confirmed after surgical excision
Pain, rapidly enlarging, firm, or restricts movement →
are benign encapsulated subepidermal nodules filled w/ fibrous tissue & keratinous (cottage cheese like) material
•cysts result from plugging of the follicular orifices
freely mobile, compressible cyst or nodule
Ruptured, infected cysts become fluctuant, painful, larger, & erythematous
: cyst wall composed of stratified squamous epithelium
complete surgical excision w/ the cyst wall intact
surfaces (forearm, elbows, knees), buttocks, back, scalp
– IgA deposition within the papillary dermis
Warts: all are caused by HPV; most resolve w/o tx over 2yrs
•a rare, lifelong hereditary disorder characterized by chronic infection w/ HPV
